question: Which three product categories had the lowest sales during the previous calendar year, excluding returned invoices?
schema:
Table: products
Columns: product_id (INTEGER), category (TEXT)

Table: invoice_items
Columns: invoice_id (INTEGER), product_id (INTEGER), line_total (REAL)

Table: sales_invoices
Columns: invoice_id (INTEGER), invoice_date (TEXT), status (TEXT)

plan.normalized_question: Return the three product categories with the lowest total line sales in the previous calendar year, excluding returned invoices.

sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(ii.line_total) AS total_sales FROM invoice_items AS ii JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ii.product_id JOIN sales_invoices AS si ON si.invoice_id = ii.invoice_id WHERE date(si.invoice_date) >= date('now','start of year','-1 year') AND date(si.invoice_date) < date('now','start of year') AND LOWER(si.status) <> 'returned' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_sales ASC LIMIT 3

question: Show revenue over the rolling 90 days by customer.
schema:
Table: customers
Columns: customer_id (INTEGER), customer_name (TEXT)

Table: sales_invoices
Columns: invoice_id (INTEGER), customer_id (INTEGER), invoice_date (TEXT), total_amount (REAL)

plan.normalized_question: Sum invoice revenue per customer for the rolling 90 days ending today.

failed_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(i.total_amount) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN sales_invoices i ON i.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY c.customer_name
repaired_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(i.total_amount) AS revenue FROM customers AS c JOIN sales_invoices AS i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE date(i.invoice_date) >= date('now','-90 days') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
